label: Rowe 2025
setting: stroke survivors; variety of settings (pre-hospital, acute, out-patient) across included studies (Table 1.1 p7-8)
diagnosis_mix: stroke survivors; no ocular diagnosis breakdown (Table 4.1 p16)
recruitment: guideline-level systematic review of vision screening in stroke (PICO 1-10); CVSQ evidence comes from one included study (ref 34, 461 non-aphasic individuals post stroke) so recruitment is NR here
cohort: CVSQ figures are secondary data from a single included primary study (ref 34, Neumann 2016); not the guideline's own cohort
notes: ESO guideline plus systematic review.
